SELECTED_INDEX: 8

EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a weak/medium band at 2728 cm⁻¹, characteristic of the aldehydic C–H stretch, and a strong C=O band at 1727 cm⁻¹, both indicative of an aliphatic aldehyde. Two medium bands at 1074 and 1121 cm⁻¹ fit the symmetric / asymmetric C–O–C stretches of an aliphatic ether, a feature absent in simple aldehydes but present in candidate 8 (CCCCO – CCC=O), which contains both an ether linkage and an aldehyde group. The other aldehydic candidates (4, 7, 9) lack an ether and thus would not account naturally for the pair of C–O–C bands near 1100 cm⁻¹. Therefore candidate 8 best matches the combination of aldehyde and ether Raman signatures observed.
